newsitem.title: UK: Dry cargo market picks up as Far East holidays end.
newsitem.headline: Dry cargo market picks up as Far East holidays end.

text.p: Brokers reported some increase in chartering activity following the end of holidays in the Far East.

Some areas of the freight market which had until recently been largely static were said to be busier, notably capers generally and handy-sizes in Argentina and Brazil. The BFI rose 6 points to 1,440 on the perception of slowly appreciating Panamax propspects.

GRAIN - Rumours circulated of Panamaxes fixed in the US Gulf/Far East trades but details were difficult to verify. The 1981-built Anna 65,077 dwt having failed on subjects with Hanjin delivery US Gulf about Feb 24 at $14,250 daily plus $250,000 bonus was linked with Pan Ocean for the same trip at $13,500 daily plus $270,000 bonus. These charterers were rumoured to have fixed and failed with the Safmarine-relet Atlantic Splendour 64,919 dwt delivery N Spain Feb 15/20 at $14,000 daily - this vessel is now said to have been booked on private terms for grain from the Plate to Indonesia. Hanjin having fixed and failed both Anna and Poros 61,203 dwt on subjects was said to have covered the Koyo-type Pantodinamos 60,000 dwt US Gulf/S Korea on private terms. In the handy-sizes Toepfer fixed about 25,000 heavy grain Plate/Alexandria and was working closely 30,000 heavy grain US Gulf to Casablanca, possibly at close to $16.00 basis 32' swad. Owners' brokers claimed that rates for handies in S America were climbing

In the east HMM booked Akra Tainaron 69,668 dwt delivery prompt S Korea for a NOPAC round at $11,600 daily and Broompark 30,670 dwt was fixed by the Indian government for grain from Australia, possibly at about $21.00/23.00 depending on loading area. New business quoted included Dreyfus with 21,500/25,500 55' US Gulf/Lisbon-Hamburg Feb 17/24 and 16/22,000 wheat Rouen/Italy Feb 24/28 (ideas $11.00), Toepfer 50,000 wheat Argentina/Aqaba March 1/15, and Cargill 30,000 up to 60,000 US Gulf/Lisbon-Hamburg including Seaforth Feb 24/March 3 (ideas $12.50 basis 49').

MINERALS - Cobelfret fixed Front Breaker for 120,000/10 coal Hampton Roads to Antwerp for March 1/15 at $6.00. The CMT-relet SG Universe 185,000 dwt open UK early March was rumoured fixed by HMM for iron ore from Brazil to S Korea, and Georgios M 148,000 dwt failed with these charterers for this business on account of size basis delivery France early March at close to $14,250 daily. Yukong was said to working CSK Fortune 65,622 dwt for Atlantic delivery for 7-9 months and Korea Line a 1984-built 65,000 dwt vessel at $11,000 against $11,500 for short period timecharter.

In the east Atlantic Savior 64,754 dwt was fixed on private terms for coal from Indonesia to Japan but Far Eastern Auspice 72,170 dwt fixed IINO delivery Taiwan about Feb 20 for a coal trip via Richards Bay to Japan at $12,000 daily but is believed to have failed on subjects.

HANDY-SIZES - Lilac Wave 42,258 dwt was rumored fixed Continent to the Far East with prompt delivery at about $12,000/12,250 daily and Alcinoe 34,500 dwt fixed continent/Bangladesh at $11,500 daily. A number of handies were fixed on subjects in the East where brokers described conditions as firmer for larger geared vessels. Erasmus 38,250 dwt open Karachi and Mariupol 27,559 dwt open Bangladesh were reported covered. Pisces Explorer 38,000 dwt open prompt Japan was fixed for a two-legged Atlantic round by Japanese charterers on subjects at close to a firm $8,000 daily.
